expected_outcomes: A new contributor can safely understand, run, and verify the project.
required_actions: Document current supported behavior and known limits.
expected_documents: Purpose, setup, architecture, verification, and change history documentation.
acceptance: Commands are exercised or labeled NOT_VERIFIED.
verification: Run documented commands in a clean environment when practical.
evidence: Command output or an explicit NOT_VERIFIED annotation.
failure_conditions: Aspirational behavior is described as complete.
exceptions: Record a time-bounded documentation exception and remediation owner.
